scope: Lexical, conservative current-source census; Rust declaration/definition names and comments excluded. SDK/dependency references count even for dormant wrappers and unrelated features; short libc names can collide. App/package evidence is not proof of execution. No-consumer means no reference in this corpus, not compiler-proven dead code. Tests/probes/build directories are excluded; local Cargo path dependencies and std sources are included, with std PAL restricted to unix. cfg is not evaluated. Resolver candidates include gated/rejected names, marked individually; wildcard Rust runtime families are not finitely enumerated. Reference locations capped at 12 per symbol per source class. No rebuild or runtime test. This is not a complete unused-by-app call graph: dormant wrappers remain unresolved. Compiler-generated imports, token-pasted names, generated-only code, and dependency sources outside Repos (including the Cargo registry) can escape the source census; packages supply positive evidence for their particular builds.
